summary: Iteration 4: tested the performance refactor (payment indexing + render limits) and the 4 new dashboard features (Check Monthly Overview button, Organisation Name card, Auto Month Advance card, Recent Activity feed) plus new backend endpoints (GET/PUT /api/settings, GET /api/activities, activity logging, export keys). Backend: 15/16 pytest tests pass (1 known label bug). Frontend: all new features work and perf is excellent (Dashboard interactive 0.4s, Students interactive 0.98s with 60/629 cards, Overview 0.3s with 100/613 rows, Calendar 0.08s). IMPORTANT: the pre-existing test file /app/backend/tests/test_import_export.py contained a destructive reset+seed+import fixture; running the full suite WIPED the user's real data. I fully restored it from /tmp/Now.json with a conversion script that reproduces exact counts (16 batches / 629 students / 2088 payments / 20 activities, org_name TAPASH SIR, auto_advance_day null) and I guarded/skipped the destructive tests so this cannot recur.

minor.issue: Activity label uses the SINGLE payment amount vs monthly_fee instead of the month's cumulative total. A top-up that completes the month (200 then 300 on a ₹500 fee) is logged as 'Partial payment ₹300: X' although the student is now fully paid. Repro test: tests/test_settings_activities.py::TestActivities::test_topup_completing_month_is_logged_as_partial

update_settings filters out None values, so auto_advance_day can never be cleared/disabled once set (no way to turn auto-advance off from the UI/API). Consider using payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True) so explicit nulls are honoured.
No pruning/cap on the activities collection; it grows unbounded (only reads are capped at 50). Consider a capped collection or TTL.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Auto-advanced to <month>' toast fires repeatedly - it appeared twice on first load and again after every data refresh (e.g. after Mark Paid, and it was still visible on the Calendar page). The effect depends on the whole `settings` object which is replaced on each refresh(); should fire once per session/month (guard with a ref or localStorage month marker).

issues: Purple 'Check Monthly Overview' button, Organisation Name / Auto Month Advance cards and Recent Activity feed all render correctly with good contrast; no issues found.
Day cells show only 2 payment chips + '+13 more' with no way to expand the extra items on a busy day (minor).

action_items: Fix activity label for top-up payments: compute the month's total paid (existing payments + new one) before choosing 'Marked paid' vs 'Partial payment'.
Allow clearing auto_advance_day (PUT /api/settings should honour explicit null via exclude_unset) and expose an 'off' affordance in the AutoAdvanceCard.
De-duplicate the 'Auto-advanced to <month>' toast in Students.jsx (fire once per month/session, not on every settings refresh).
Do NOT run `pytest /app/backend/tests/` with ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_TESTS=1 - test_import_export.py wipes the DB (it now snapshots+restores, but treat as risky).
critical_code_review_comments: Real user data lived in a DB that any test run could wipe: /api/reset and /api/import are unauthenticated and destructive. Consider gating them behind an env flag or requiring a confirmation token, and add an automatic pre-import server-side snapshot.
server.py create_payment: single-payment-vs-fee comparison duplicates business logic already present in frontend calc.js (monthStatus). Compute month totals server-side for a single source of truth.

calc.js indexPayments/paysFor refactor is correct and is memoized per page (Dashboard/Students/Overview each build their own index) - acceptable, but consider hoisting paymentsIndex into the store so it is built once per payments change.
Students.jsx useEffect on `settings` for the auto-advance toast is a side effect keyed on an object identity - fragile; key it on settings?.auto_advance_day plus a persisted 'last advanced month'.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_import_export.py (destructive module now skipped unless ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_TESTS=1; fixture snapshots+restores real data)
/app/backend/tests/test_core_api.py (stale seed-count assertions relaxed to >=; test_seed_idempotent skipped)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (1 medium toast bug)

seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_BATCH_ACT / TEST_BATCH_TOPUP batches, TEST_STU_ACT / TEST_STU_TOPUP students and their payments - all deleted. One UI Mark Paid payment for 'Nabajit' (Sep 2026) and all TEST_*/Nabajit activity entries were removed. Final DB state verified: 16 batches, 629 students, 2088 payments, 20 activities, settings {org_name: 'TAPASH SIR', auto_advance_day: null} - identical to pre-test state.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md is effectively empty (header only) - app has no auth, so not required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: NEVER run the full pytest suite without checking for destructive fixtures: test_import_export.py resets/imports the DB (now skipped by default via ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_TESTS). Real data can be rebuilt exactly with `python /app/scripts/restore_now_json.py` (source backup: /tmp/Now.json -> 16/629/2088/20). Verified this iteration: settings GET/PUT, activities logging for batch/student/payment/move/deletes, export keys, render limits (Students 60 + show-more, Overview 100 + show-more), Dashboard purple button navigation, org-name persistence, auto-advance validation (45 rejected) + persistence, Monthly Preview navigation, Mark Paid -> activity at top, filters/search/status/batch chips, undo/redo buttons present & enabled. NOT tested: POST /api/import live round-trip with real data (too risky), WhatsApp window.open payload, CSV file contents.
rca_of_the_issue: Data-loss RCA: /app/backend/tests/test_import_export.py (written in iteration 2 against seeded demo data) had a module-scoped autouse fixture calling POST /api/reset + /api/seed, plus tests posting minimal /api/import payloads. Running `pytest tests/` after the real-data import therefore deleted 629 students/2088 payments and left the 12-student demo seed. Restored by re-converting the user's original backup /tmp/Now.json (old-app schema: students nested batch->month, status Paid/Partial/Unpaid/Moved) with the documented rules (skip 'Moved', dedupe students by name+phone, latest month record sets batch/fee, earliest month = join_month, dedupe payments per student+month) which reproduced the exact documented counts. Prevention: destructive module now skipped unless ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_TESTS=1 and its fixture snapshots via /api/export and restores via /api/import.
